maddeler.e:
تصابرت (form VI)
# تَصَابَرْتُ (taṣābartu) /ta.sˤaː.bar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَصَابَرَ (taṣābara)
# تَصَابَرْتَ (taṣābarta) /ta.sˤaː.bar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَصَابَرَ (taṣābara)
# تَصَابَرْتِ (taṣābarti) /ta.sˤaː.bar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَصَابَرَ (taṣābara)
# تَصَابَرَتْ (taṣābarat) /ta.sˤaː.ba.rat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
